div.div:
Fan-out snapshot: 1 client → 1 Apigee instance (path-based routing, no involvement in backend scaling) → 3 services, each autoscaling independently (2-4 instances shown: payments 3, transactions 4, customer-details 2) → 9 service instances total.
Every Cloud Run instance is a 2-container pod: Envoy terminates ingress (JWT/routing) before the app container ever sees the request. 9 instances × 2 containers = 9 Envoy sidecars + 9 app containers = 18 containers running for this snapshot alone.
